Changed-since line: count and mark the atoms newer than --since; the default is the latest session_ended of the branch-bound record, and with neither the line is omitted. The ~2.5k figure OVERSTATES the median about 2x; it falls between p50 and p90. The line costs 19 tokens, below the smallest pull (606).
